title: The Mixtape of the water tower
author: Elodie Eastwick
blurb: Tamsin Underhill, the new kid at a school built over something old, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must save the tradition that made the town, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
